interpretation: CLI success and report existence do not establish custom-rule acceptance. The same 0.1 mm track triggers a 0.15 mm width violation with the independent fixed-decimal control and comments-only corrected deck. It does not trigger that violation with the original generated deck, scientific-literal control, or versionless merge. The report labels the minimum board setup constraints even for the control; the generated corrected deck sets warning severity as requested.
